compute_transitive_deps: compute the transitive closure of dependencies for a given node using depth-first traversal and topological sorting
run_mako_plugin: run the mako plugin to add transitive_deps to all targets and python dependencies in a build dictionary
build_dependency_graph: build a dependency graph from a YAML dictionary of libs and targets with transitive dependency resolution
review_transitive_deps_function: review the transitive_deps function to understand its recursive depth-first traversal and topological sorting approach
refactor_mako_plugin: refactor the mako_plugin to support additional target types beyond libs and python_dependencies
